issues.detail: The Hebrew text has 'בֵּית הַבָּעַל' (house of Baal) and 'עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל' (servants/worshippers of Baal), but the Chinese renders these as '主人的家' (house of the master) and '事奉主人的人' (those who serve the master), replacing the divine name Baal with a generic 'master' (主人). This changes the proper name and the identity of the deity being referenced.
